scope: inference/useful-work, authorized operations, operating economics, maintainer workflow and recipient delivery

inference_useful_work.evidence: Retained cross-accelerator Run3 grades and raw observations; vLLM streamed trials; published endpoint collector
inference_useful_work.remaining: Wider representative application/AgentX outcomes and qualified runtime/accelerator comparisons under explicit model, precision and operating conditions.

operational_audits.evidence: Published provider research, reverified owned peer/storage/recovery observations, and executable recipient-owned operational collection with explicit observation/declaration boundaries.
operational_audits.remaining: Qualify the bounded authorized named-route network gate on real hosts; extend broader security/monitoring/lifecycle/availability/performance and provider coverage. Local/owned route evidence does not imply commercial SLA or model endpoint health.

economics.evidence: Retained accepted-work cost scenarios, price histories, decision sensitivity, scoped board telemetry
economics.remaining: Attributable fuller-system energy and actual operating-cost evidence where available; include failures/retries/verification/operator/idle costs or explicit sourced assumptions.

maintainer_workflow.acceptance: Independent recipient can compare baseline/candidate with representative fixed workload, streamed raw observations, exact accepted outcomes, repeated comparisons, changed-factor attribution, thresholds and CI exits; demonstrate regression, incompatibility and fresh-observation semantics.

stages.publication: Exact source qualification and Pages deployment are recorded by this commit's GitHub Actions runs.
stages.explicit_regrading: Implemented: separately pinned grading contract reuses immutable captures, binds both arms and creates a distinct retained decision identity.
stages.packet_dependency: Packet adapter and workbench bundle updates preserve capture dependencies; collector/parser changes invalidate observation identity.
stages.native_comparison_review: Implemented: single data-only bundle, trusted native verdict, explicit post-hoc policy history and original evidence export; qualified by app/tests/check_comparison_workbench.py.
stages.joined_deployment_job: Implemented; exact source and extracted recipient acceptance required by the release workflow.

empirical.energy_scope: GPU0 board telemetry integrated over measured trial windows; host and facility excluded.

features: explicit authorized owned TLS health route
source-bound required network latency and failure gates

recipient_publication.remaining: Public activation is gated by successful exact-source qualification and recorded in GitHub Actions. The broader original scope retains its separate residuals.

joined_deployment_job.capability: Recipient-owned paired capture, exact application acceptance, supported local operations, full source-labeled scenario allocations, retained child analyses, separate retry campaigns and bounded data-only export/import.
joined_deployment_job.qualification: Exact release qualification is recorded by the current commit GitHub Actions and retained owner receipts. Tests distinguish authored HTTP fixtures, actual sandbox executions and source-bound model observations.
joined_deployment_job.native_regression: The retained 192-request vLLM pair remains incomparable at 21/96 accepted per arm under its original 80% requirement.
joined_deployment_job.remaining: Representative general agentic tasks, controlled wider runtime/accelerator comparisons, broader real provider audits, full-system metering and observed production costs, and independent external recipient adoption.

owned_network_gate.entry: CLI collect-network; existing requirement JSON and retained decision rendering
owned_network_gate.scope: One explicitly authorized named owned TLS health route; bounded complete-attempt latency/failure evidence, declared collector/responder identity, certificate/nonce/body/source binding and required deployment gates.
owned_network_gate.software_evidence: Synthetic transport, actual native receipt/HTTP fixture integration, immutable child/data-only import, and real previously qualified repaired recovery-bundle compatibility regression. Exact artifact qualification is recorded separately by release receipts.
owned_network_gate.remaining: Live cross-host acquisition with declared target/source custody and applicable native run; no SLA, model endpoint health, remote execution attestation or general provider-security qualification.

current_work.source_identity: Use the exact Git commit and recipient manifest for this checkout; producer commits identify source custody.
current_work.owned_network_gate: Source-reviewed narrow extension; exact release qualification and live acceptance remain separately recorded. Preserve full inference/operations/economics/recipient scope.

evidence_policy: Preserve source, conditions, date, failures and observed/published/modeled/unknown basis. Fresh observation and retained analysis are distinct.

outcome.closure: Scope-specific evidence must satisfy inference/useful-work, operations, economics and recipient acceptance.
